findings.quote: among them, the Eleans dwell exceptionally well off
findings.problem: Greek is a fragment: [...]νόντων, οἰκοῦσι διαφερόντως Ἠλεῖοι = 'the Eleans inhabit [the country] especially/above all'. Nothing in the Greek corresponds to 'well off'; it is invented, and 'among them' is supplied to cover the gap. The text before the break is lost (lacuna), so the exact sense of what they inhabit is unrecoverable.
findings.proposed_fix: among them [...], the Eleans especially make their homes

units.note: Chapter opens mid-sentence (lost text); the opening [...] is correct, but 'well off' smooths the gap. Rest of chapter is accurate.
Cities (nine), 600 Aetolians, c.500 mercenaries, 1000 citizens all match. 'Tarentine cavalry' adds 'cavalry' not in the Greek (Ταραντίνους only), but not a sense error.
Numbers (1000/1000/500/200; six days) and names (Taurion, Ladicus, Epitalium) match.

findings.quote: but after whom Fortune turned against them
findings.problem: Greek: ἕως τῆς ἐν Λεύκτροις μάχης, αὖτις ἐπὶ τἀναντία τραπείσης αὐτοῖς τῆς τύχης = 'down to the battle of Leuctra, after which Fortune turned to the opposite for them'. 'after whom' wrongly makes a person the antecedent; it is the time/battle of Leuctra.
findings.proposed_fix: but then Fortune turned against them
